value.name: incipit
value.summary: Template-driven CLI for transforming structured resume data into polished PDFs, DOCX, HTML, LaTeX, and Markdown, featuring pluggable templates and multi-agent AI assessment. Built with Go and supports extensive output formats.

value.name: mnemonist
value.summary: Open ecosystem for tool-agnostic AI agent memory, implemented in Rust and Python. Enables seamless memory integration across diverse AI frameworks.

value.name: saige
value.summary: Unified Go SDK and CLI for streaming AI agents, knowledge graphs, and RAG pipelines. Designed for scalable AI workflows and graph-based knowledge management.

value.name: flappy-bird
value.summary: Flappy Bird clone using JavaFX and Java 21, showcasing data-oriented design patterns and automated native builds for Linux, macOS, and Windows.

value.name: chess-cli
value.summary: Fully playable chess game with object-oriented design and command-line interface in Python, ideal for learning game logic and exploring chess AI algorithms.

value.name: teasr
value.summary: Rust-based tool for capturing showcase screenshots and GIFs from web apps, desktop, and terminal, delivered as a single binary with no runtime dependencies.

value.name: linear-gp
value.summary: Production-grade Rust framework for Linear Genetic Programming research, featuring modular architecture, Q-Learning integration, and automated hyperparameter optimization for reinforcement learning and classification tasks.

value.name: lepus-classifier
value.summary: CNN research project investigating optimal image classification architectures for small datasets, highlighting data quantity as the key bottleneck in deep learning.

value.name: dotfiles
value.summary: Cross-platform dotfiles managed by Chezmoi, supporting Homebrew/apt, per-language version managers, and one-command bootstrap for macOS and Linux with Neovim, Tmux, Zsh, and AI agent skills.

value.name: md-classifier
value.summary: Deep learning system combining transformers and CNNs to classify diseases from patient-described symptoms, achieving high recall through semantic embeddings and feature extraction.

value.name: lazyspeak.nvim
value.summary: Voice-driven coding plugin for Neovim, enabling users to speak their intent and see edits appear in the editor, built with Lua and Rust.

value.name: generative-artifact-protocol
value.summary: Open standard for token-efficient artifact updates and streaming, featuring a Rust apply engine and evaluation CLI. Supports multi-language integration for generative workflows.

value.name: github-insights
value.summary: AI-powered GitHub profile metrics with SVG visualizations, project classification, and README generation. Available as CLI, npm package, and GitHub Action.

value.name: gymnasia
value.summary: Pure Rust implementation of OpenAI Gymnasium environments, enabling reinforcement learning experimentation without Python dependencies.

value.name: urmzd.com
value.summary: Personal website, blog, and research portfolio built with Astro, React, and Three.js, showcasing interactive content and technical projects.

value.name: fsrc
value.summary: CLI, crate, and GitHub Action for embedding source files into any text file using comment markers, implemented in Rust and Python.

value.name: dispatch
value.summary: Beta control plane for agent execution nodes, enabling deployment and scaling of sandboxed agents with metrics on a shared workspace, built with Go.

value.name: agentspec
value.summary: Universal agent skill and sub-agent manager with a terminal user interface, implemented in Rust and Shell.

value.name: rlgp-thesis
value.summary: BCS thesis project on Reinforced Linear Genetic Programming, documented in TeX and Shell.

value.name: glassbox-lm
value.summary: Testbed for observable language models where every hidden state is a readable distribution over words, designed for interpretability by construction in Python.

value.name: lightning-kfold
value.summary: Stratified K-fold cross-validation with ensemble voting for PyTorch Lightning, providing a drop-in solution for robust model evaluation.

value.name: zoro
value.summary: Privacy-first AI research agent with a persistent knowledge graph, running all inference locally and connecting ideas securely, built with Go and Python.

value.name: oag
value.summary: Fast OpenAPI 3.x code generator for TypeScript, React/SWR, and FastAPI, offering zero runtime dependencies and first-class SSE streaming, implemented in Rust.

value.name: sr
value.summary: Release engineering CLI in Rust, providing automated semantic versioning from conventional commits as a single static binary with zero runtime dependencies.

value.name: languide
value.summary: Scenario-based language guides built from markdown, generating PDFs with full Unicode and CJK support for communication-focused learning.

value.name: urmzd
value.summary: GitHub profile README auto-generating project highlights and activity summaries.

value.name: streamsafe
value.summary: Type-safe async pipeline framework for data processing in Rust, supporting robust and scalable workflows.

value.name: zigbee-skill
value.summary: AI-native smart home skill enabling direct control of Zigbee devices by AI agents, with no cloud or hub required, implemented in Go.

value.name: cypress-name-too-long-mre
value.summary: Minimal reproducible example for Cypress testing, using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

value.name: barter-trader
value.summary: Community-focused Android trading app built with Clean Architecture and MVVM, enabling peer-to-peer item exchanges with enterprise-grade mobile development patterns.

preamble.value: I design scalable AI workflows from scratch, focusing on streaming agent SDKs and modular memory systems. Projects like saige and mnemonist show how I use Go and Rust to build unified tools for graph-based knowledge and seamless agent integration.
